title: Woman in Swimsuit at Beach, 1950s B&W Ocean Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white square snapshot featuring deckle edges, depicting a woman standing calf-deep in ocean waters near a rocky breakwater and concrete sea wall. She is dressed in a mid-century style white strapless bathing suit or playsuit. In the background, small waves roll onto the shore and several distant figures are perched along the top of the seawall. The back of the photo exhibits remnants of glue and album paper residue along the top edge, with no handwritten annotations or stamps present.
